files.README.md:
# Mobile signal buffer

Signals accumulate while the mobile link is unavailable. On reconnection the pending items are emitted in one frame.
files.src/main.js:
import { flushPendingSignals } from './buffer.js';
 export function onReconnect(pending, sink) { return flushPendingSignals(pending, sink); }
